h: Court remands man accused of threatening to leak private images of Kano Governor Yusuf
p: A Federal High Court in Abuja has reportedly ordered that Sanusi Dankaka be remanded over an alleged threat to leak private images of Governor Abba Yusuf. The case is said to be at an early stage.
more: The defendant has yet to be tried on the allegation.
The matter is expected to return to court at a later date.
